en.headline: National Day half-price cinema scheme drew 153,000
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association said 52 cinemas screened 1,789 shows of 62 films under the 1 October offer.
body: The National Day half-price cinema scheme drew more than 153,000 admissions, the Hong Kong Theatres Association said after the one-day offer closed. The association organised the programme, with funding from the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and from the Film Development Fund.

Fifty-two cinemas across Hong Kong took part on 1 October, screening 1,789 shows of 62 films, the association said. It said sessions in several districts sold out, and that popular titles went quickly under the government-backed half-price subsidy. Tickets for the day, including different formats, were sold at half price, with some exceptions for private hires and special programmes.

The association also said the screenings pulled trade to nearby businesses. It cited a Tsuen Wan cafe whose takings rose by about 30 per cent on a buy-one-get-one coffee offer tied to the day, and a Tsim Sha Tsui restaurant that reported stronger evening bookings alongside the fireworks. Some eateries offered discounts against a ticket stub.
The figures were released on Friday evening, after the holiday screenings. The association said it hoped further public offers would keep people coming into cinemas and the shops around them.

zh.headline: 國慶半價睇戲吸引逾15.3萬人次
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會指全港52間戲院參與，當日放映1,789場、62套電影，多區場次爆滿。
body: 香港戲院商會表示，國慶日「10.1半價睇好戲」結束後，統計全日吸引超過15.3萬人次入場。活動由戲院商會主辦，文化體育及旅遊局轄下文創產業發展處及電影發展基金資助。
商會說，當日全港52間戲院參與，放映1,789場、上映62套電影，多區場次爆滿。受惠於半價資助，多套熱門電影戲票很快售罄，有市民預早訂票，亦有觀眾即場買票入座。當日各類票價半價，包場及特備節目除外。
商會又指活動帶動戲院周邊消費。荃灣一間咖啡店配合推出咖啡買一送一，當日生意額增加約三成；尖沙咀有餐廳稱，戲院優惠加上煙花匯演令晚市訂座上升。部分食肆憑戲票存根提供餐飲或購物折扣。
入場數字於周五晚公布。商會表示，期望日後有更多類似優惠，鼓勵市民入戲院及帶動商場人流。
